key_insight: Resource-efficient Knapsack QUBO formulations improve optimal-solution success rates, with a slackless formulation delivering gains of several orders of magnitude.
engineering_relevance: Choosing a better QUBO formulation can reduce encoding overhead and improve quantum optimization performance without changing the underlying Knapsack problem.
method: Derive a smaller penalty constant for the standard formulation.
Reduce the number of slack variables used to encode the capacity constraint.
Use an alternative formulation that eliminates slack variables entirely.
evidence_signal: All three approaches improved success probabilities in LR-QAOA simulations and on a D-Wave quantum annealer; the slackless method performed best, even for relatively small instances.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish large-instance scalability or an advantage over classical Knapsack solvers.
paper_title: Resource-efficient formulations of the Knapsack problem for quantum computing
